diagnosis: Rollout 3 failed checks C6 and C8, dropping the pass count to the gate threshold. C6.why: The supplier certificate changes the battery assignment from the two plausible unused options, C-2 or C-5, to C-2 and adds the required vented-and-grounded container control.

fix_instructions: The sole failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH on C6 and C8 in rollout 3. Both PF1 and PF3 were revealed and cited correctly; the settlement simply did not emit the required handling_control commitment entries. To fix: tighten the settle-eligibility condition or the settlement schema instructions so that every handling-control requirement attached to a credited fact must appear as a distinct commitment of type handling_control, not merely be implied by a documentation commitment. Specifically, C6 should require a handling_control commitment referencing vented and grounded for C-2/battery modules (per PF1), and C8 should require a handling_control commitment referencing refrigeration or shore-power verification on C-1 by 0700 Friday (per PF3). Alternatively, broaden the wording of C6 and C8 to accept documentation commitments that explicitly contain the control language (e.g., "axle-balanced," "vented and grounded," "shore power connected and verified"), since the model sometimes encodes the control inside a documentation commitment rather than as a separate handling_control entry.
